source: Shengyi Electronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)

players.product: High-layer-count (30+ layer) and high-order (5-6 step) HDI PCBs for AI servers, plus high-speed boards for 800G/1.6T switches and optical modules

quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Electronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (unaudited): operating revenue RMB 5,783,539,107.99, up 53.46% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 1,110,707,603.86, up 109.36%; operating cash flow RMB 917,444,111.04 (+112.09%). The company attributes revenue growth to strong global AI server and high-performance computing demand and a clearly higher share of high-value-added products.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Electronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AI server PCBs are the company's core growth line: it has broken through 5-6 step high-order HDI and 30+ layer high-multilayer boards; products passed certification by leading global computing platforms and are in large-scale batch delivery, with synchronous development alongside mainstream cloud vendors and server companies in China and overseas. The company flags that server orders and overseas revenue are a relatively high share of its business.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Electronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Networking and optics: 1.6T high-end switch boards entered small-batch mass production; 800G optical module PCBs are in volume production with shipments rising; 1.6T optical module PCBs are in sampling and testing. Satellite communication: ground equipment boards in small-batch supply and orders for satellite-borne products growing.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Electronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: output area up 24.73% YoY with overall line utilization kept high. Dongcheng intelligent computing center high-multilayer HDI board project phase 1 is ramping and phase 2 was gradually put into use; Ji'an high-multilayer computing board project stage 1 was completed and started production at period end, with annual capacity of 70 (ten-thousand square metres) when fully built; Thailand plant phase 1 is in equipment installation and trial-production preparation; the Dongguan AI computing HDI base (5-step and above HDI incl. mSAP) started construction ahead of schedule. Construction in progress RMB 1,518,503,251.17. Management: in H1 2026 high-multilayer and high-order HDI demand stayed strong, industry supply was structurally tight and upstream laminate prices rose in several rounds.
quarterly_data.figure: Output area +24.73%; construction in progress RMB 1,518,503,251.17

quarterly_data.signal: Related-party supply: in H1 2026 the company bought RMB 58,472.69 (ten-thousand) of copper-clad laminate, prepreg and other materials from its controlling shareholder Shengyi Technology (Guangdong Shengyi Sci. Tech) and subsidiaries, 16.26% of same-type purchases; Shengyi Technology holds 62.50% of the company. Inventory RMB 2,290,046,567.47 (+50.08%) on more orders.

Shengyi Electronics.why: Chinese PCB maker whose AI server high-multilayer / high-order HDI boards and 800G-1.6T switch and optical-module boards drive its growth (H1 2026 revenue +53.46% on AI server and HPC demand); its stock tracks AI server board demand.
Shengyi Electronics.evidence: Shengyi Electronics 2026 half-year report: broke through 5-6 step HDI and 30+ layer boards; products passed certification by leading global computing platforms and are in large-scale batch delivery; 1.6T switch boards in small-batch mass production.
